name: Product Size Charts Plugin for WooCommerce, Size Table, Size Chart Popup – WPBean
author: WPBean

sections.description:
Product Size Charts Plugin for WooCommerce is a powerful and beginner-friendly WooCommerce plugin that helps customers find the right product size before purchasing. Easily create beautiful and customizable product size charts, size guides, and size tables for your WooCommerce products and categories.

Whether you sell clothing, shoes, helmets, bags, or any size-dependent products, this plugin makes it easy to display accurate sizing information and improve the shopping experience. Providing detailed product size charts helps reduce returns, increase customer confidence, and boost conversions.

Display your WooCommerce product size charts in a modern popup, product tab, Elementor widget, or anywhere using shortcodes. The clean and responsive design ensures your size guides are always accessible without cluttering your product pages.

The plugin comes with an intuitive size chart table builder that lets you create and manage multiple size charts for different products, categories, and store requirements.

You can also customize the size chart button text, style, position, and popup appearance to match your WooCommerce store design perfectly.

Live Demo | Documentation | Upgrade to Pro!

Why Use Product Size Charts for WooCommerce?

  • Reduce product returns and exchanges by providing accurate sizing information.
  • Increase customer confidence before making a purchase.
  • Improve WooCommerce store conversions and sales.
  • Create a better shopping experience for your customers.
  • Display international size conversions for global buyers.
  • Reduce support requests related to sizing issues.
  • Build trust with professional and easy-to-read size guides.
  • Help customers make informed buying decisions.

Product Size Charts Plugin for WooCommerce Features

  • Create unlimited WooCommerce product size charts.
  • Build customizable size chart tables for your products.
  • Assign size charts to specific WooCommerce products.
  • Assign size charts to WooCommerce product categories.
  • Display size charts in popup windows or product tabs.
  • Customize the size chart button text and position.
  • Show product size charts using Elementor widgets.
  • Display size guides using shortcodes.
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly design.
  • Translation ready and RTL supported.
  • Easy setup with a beginner-friendly interface.

Product Size Charts Pro Features

  • Create unlimited rows and columns for advanced size chart tables.
  • Assign pre-built size charts directly from the product edit page.
  • Multiple modern table design presets.
  • Advanced button styling and customization options.
  • Complete popup design customization settings.
  • Dedicated Elementor widget for product size chart display.
  • Priority customer support.
  • More flexibility for managing large WooCommerce stores.

Perfect For WooCommerce Stores Selling

  • Clothing and Fashion Products
  • Shoes and Footwear
  • Helmets and Safety Equipment
  • Sports and Outdoor Products
  • Bags and Accessories
  • Kids and Baby Products
  • Furniture and Home Products
  • Any WooCommerce products that require sizing information

Why Choose WPBean Product Size Chart Plugin?

Unlike generic size chart plugins, WPBean Product Size Chart for WooCommerce is designed to be lightweight, easy to use, and highly customizable. You can quickly create professional-looking product size charts without writing any code.

The plugin is built with modern development practices and offers seamless integration with WooCommerce and Elementor, making it suitable for both beginners and advanced WooCommerce store owners.

Support and Documentation:

Using this plugin is incredibly simple. We provide detailed online documentation to help you get started quickly.

Documentation: https://docs.wpbean.com/docs/wpb-product-size-charts-for-woocommerce/

If you need any assistance, our support team is always ready to help.
sections.installation:
• Install the plugin like any other WordPress plugin.
  • Activate the plugin from the Plugins page.
  • Navigate to Dashboard > Size Charts.
  • Create your product size charts and configure the settings.
  • Assign size charts to your WooCommerce products or categories.
  • Follow our detailed documentation for advanced configurations.
sections.faq:
What is Product Size Charts Plugin for WooCommerce?

It is a WooCommerce plugin that allows you to create and display customizable product size charts and size guides for your products and categories.

Can I assign different size charts to different products?

Yes. You can create multiple size charts and assign them to specific WooCommerce products and product categories.

Can I display the woocommerce size chart in a popup?

Yes. You can display your product size charts inside a beautiful popup window or product tabs.

Does this plugin work with Elementor?

Yes. The Pro version includes a dedicated Elementor widget for displaying WooCommerce product size charts.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. The plugin is fully responsive and works perfectly on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

Will it work with my WooCommerce theme?

We regularly test the plugin with popular free and premium WordPress themes. It should work with any standard WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Why should I use WPB Product Size Charts Plugin for WooCommerce?

The plugin is lightweight, easy to configure, highly customizable, and designed specifically for WooCommerce store owners who want to improve customer experience and reduce size-related returns.
